title: Go where the heart is washed clean
summary: The saints' presence washes ego and turns the heart toward Naam. Take the question into sangat.
lifeApplication: Before starting one more private search, step into sangat, kirtan, or one truthful conversation.

source.shortMeaning: The saints' presence washes ego and turns the heart toward Naam.
source.lifeApplication: When comparison dirties the mind, move toward holy company before feeding it.

evidence.coreClaim: The saints' presence washes ego and turns the heart toward Naam.
evidence.turn: Seek the company that washes the heart and turns it toward Naam.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before starting one more private search, step into sangat, kirtan, or one truthful conversation.
